main.description: Hands the community's protected owner role from the caller to another member. The subject gains every protected role the caller holds, then the caller loses them. The caller keeps their other roles.

community.description: The community whose ownership is transferred.

subject.description: The member who becomes the owner.

owner.description: The new owner, with their updated roles.

previousOwner.description: The caller, with their updated roles.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller does not hold a protected owner role in this community.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists with that DID.

errors.name: MemberNotFound
errors.description: The subject does not hold a member record in this community.

errors.name: Banned
errors.description: The subject is banned from this community.

errors.name: AlreadyOwner
errors.description: The subject already holds a protected owner role.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView's stored credentials for this community are missing or unusable.
